englishRecognitionQualification.purpose: Fix desktop transcription to English instead of auto language guessing for short commands. Preserve exact wake/completion matching and existing VAD/confidence settings.
englishRecognitionQualification.method: Compare the same cached CPU/int8 base model and confidence filter over 16 Kokoro-derived/silence/noise fixtures in auto, English, and English-plus-Ivy-hotword modes. Then run actual packaged native WebView/worker using controlled synthetic I think, Ivy and Im done audio.
englishRecognitionQualification.rejectedHotwordReason: The Ivy vocabulary boost changed one full Ivory negative fixture into an exact leading Ivy match. No hotword or vocabulary prompt is added.

limitations: The clean synthetic clips were already correctly recognized in auto mode; these runs do not reproduce or prove correction of the reported physical I think/Und dann errors.
